technique_name: Write an essay about the recent advances in artificial intelligence and its implications.
description: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have revolutionized the way many tasks in our daily life are performed. They have profoundly impacted business, industry and creativity, while greatly increasing efficiency and improving accuracy. In addition to its easier to perceive benefits like in automation and robotics, AI has also been used to solve more complex tasks like natural language processing, image recognition and autonomous navigation.
